items.title: Show HN: Local historical wind and gust visualizer
items.contentSnippet:
Quite a niche project that shows in a neat way historical wind force and orientation, anywhere on earth.
No particular use case in mind, apart from checking that my next house will not be affected by the Mistral wind (the horrendous wind displayed in the default coordinates of the app).
Based on weather reanalysis of ERA5, ERA5-LAND and ECMWF IFS provided by open-meteo.com
Entirely Vibe coded with DeepSeek 4.1 Flash and Opencode.

items.title: Show HN: MCUHex – Flash and Live Monitoring for STM32 Devices over SWD
items.contentSnippet:
I built MCUHex for monitoring  global/static variables and flashing Arm Cortex-M devices over SWD protocol.
Connect ST-Link debug probe and drop .elf/.out file. It parses the debug info into a tree of global/static variables with types and addresses. You can read/write addresses in the memory and watch them live in chart view. It can also flash .elf/.hex/.bin files.

items.title: Show HN: 100 Player Online Smash Bros
items.contentSnippet:
I used GPT-6 Astra and the recent Melee decomp project (https://github.com/doldecomp/melee) to make an online battle royale mod. 100 players in a box, in stamina mode. The last player alive wins.
You will need a good ping/wired internet to run this properly. It works with some controllers out of the box (Xbox for example), but I'm working on figuring out Gamecube controllers.
